---
name: Bug Report (QA Verified)
about: Create a structured report to help the team reproduce and fix a defect
title: "[BUG] <Brief summary of defect>"
labels: bug, needs-triage
assignees: ''

---

### Defect Overview
**Summary:** Clear and concise description of what the bug is.

### Reproduction Steps
1. Navigate to '...'
2. Click on '....'
3. Scroll down to '....'
4. Observe the error/behavior

### Expected Behavior
A clear and concise description of what should happen according to the PRD/SRS.

### Actual Behavior
What actually occurred during testing.

### Environment & Device Specifications
- **Platform:** Android / iOS / Web
- **Device / Model:** (e.g., Pixel 7 / iPhone 14)
- **OS Version:** (e.g., Android 14, iOS 17)
- **App Version / Build:** (e.g., v1.0.0-rc2)
- **Network Condition:** 4G / 5G / Offline (Airplane Mode)

### Supporting Logs & Media
- Add screenshots, screen recordings, or log snippets if available.

### QA Severity & Priority
- **Severity:** Critical (Blocks workflow) / Major (Core feature flawed) / Minor (Visual/Cosmetic)
- **Priority:** P0 / P1 / P2
